title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E10 — The Barracuda
Lamont strongly objects to his father's proposal of marriage to the widow Donna Harris (Lynn Hamilton). Lamont's protestations that no one can take the place of his mother leads to a heated three?way argument and one fiery exit.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E11 — Tv Or Not Tv
Fred wants a color television and Lamont wants a car, but they can't afford both. Fred, enraged to learn that Lamont went ahead and bought the car, ends up in the hospital with amnesia, a very sympathetic son and a suspicious twinkle in his eye.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E12 — Suitcase Case
Lamont stumbles upon a suitcase full of what he's sure is stolen money and calls the police to come take it away. Not wanting to take any chances, Fred locks the find up in the safe.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E13 — Return Of The Barracuda
Fred and Donna have reconciled their differences and are once again planning to wed. Fred even gives her an engagement ring to make it official.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E11 — Costume Party, The
George's cleaning business may be cleaned up for good when he resorts to playing a dirty trick in order to secure the business of a large costume company.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E12 — Florence Gets Lucky
George must make a painful admission when he discovers he needs Florence far more than he could ever expect.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E13 — George Needs Help
When George stubbornly refuses to hire some badly needed help for his store, Louise and Florence combine forces to make him change his mind.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E14 — The Jefferson Curve
After watching George Jefferson in action, his young protege Marcus bends the truth to win the heart of a young lady and throws a curve that lands Lionel in foul territory.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E15 — 984 W. 124th., Apt. 5c
When Louise discovers that George has been sending presents and money to a mysterious address, she follows him to find out why and is shocked...and touched by what she sees.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E16 — George And Whitty
George and Louise are stunned by their landlord Whittendale's plans to evict them, but their biggest surprise is yet to come when they invite him down to discuss it.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E17 — Lionel Gets The Business
George is on cloud nine when he finally persuades Lionel to join him in the family's cleaning business -- until Lionel starts taking him to the cleaners.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E18 — Blackout, The
George blows a fuse when a power blackout hits the city and looters do the same to his store.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S4 E1 — Buddy Hackett, Ruth Buzzi, Richard Pryor
Flip & Pryor are in tenement politics; it’s parent’s night at school; Pryor does stand-up and the whole cast winds up in the hospital.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S4 E2 — Monty Hall, Sandy Duncan, William Windom, The Pointer Sisters
Cast does prop skits; Windom does a dramatic scene and Sandy, the Pointers & Geraldine join Monty on Let's Make A Deal.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E6 — Bill Withers/Mae Jackson
Featured guest Bill Withers sings hit single, "Ain't No Sunshine" and other selections from his album, Just As I Am.  In another segment, young poetess Mae Jackson reads from her own works.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E7 — Miriam Makeba/Muhammad Ali
Former heavyweight boxing champion Muhammad Ali, South African born singer Miriam Makeba and a three-man vocal group called the Delfonics, share the spotlight with guest-host Nikki Giovanni, who opens the show with her "Kidnap Poem".

title: Webster
description:
S5 E4 — Breaking Away
An enthusiastic George takes the family on a fishing trip, but all Webster can think about is the fun he could be having with his buddies.

title: Webster
description:
S5 E5 — The Strike
The unconventional methods of Webster's teacher earn him an A from the students and a pink slip from an outraged PTA.

title: Webster
description:
S5 E6 — George's Brush With Life
After learning that his buddies from school have died, George quits his job and resolves to live life to the hilt.

title: Webster
description:
S5 E7 — The Importance of Being Worthy
Webster and Nicky's excitement over a fund-raiser they organized fizzles when the proceeds are stolen.

title: Webster
description:
S5 E8 — A Hell of a Weekend
A weekend at Wisconsin Dells with parents of Webster's best friend reveals more than Katherine and George want to see, they are nudists.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S1 E4 — Cheater, Cheater
Tamera cajoles Tia into helping her cheat on a test in order to win Ray's approval.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S1 E5 — Out Alone
While taking a bus to the movies, Tia and Tamera fight over the disadvantages of being a twin, but when they get lost, they must team up to find their way home.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S1 E6 — The Pimple
When a pimple pops up just before Tia's big date, Tamera agrees to step in for her -- and finds herself falling for Tia's guy.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S1 E7 — Car Trouble
Tamera scratches the fender of her father's prized car, then tries to hide the truth with the help of Tia and Roger.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S1 E8 — The Birthday
The twins' first birthday together leaves Tamera's best friend feeling left out, and Ray locked in an argument with Lisa over his parenting methods.

title: Moesha
description:
S3 E3 — Day One
Mo attends the first day at her new school and is miserable.  She has only made one friend and feels out of place.
